rules.eu: The consolidated version of Reg. 833/2014 applied is the latest consolidated version dated on or before the date (the date in its CELEX number); the vessel is listed when Annex XLII of that version has an entry with its IMO number, and where that version has no Annex XLII the status is 'annex did not exist'. Whether 'as at' should instead mean the law applying on that date (entry into force, dates of application, a version EUR-Lex published later) is pending owner.
rules.eu_pending: Shown beside the EU status, not merged into it: acts the Publications Office loaded on or before the date (the calendar date of its own timestamp, its local time) that are not consolidated in the version applied and that add or remove the vessel, read from the act's own text (ojparse.xlii_changes, F1). Acts SanctionDesk has not recorded are not known; corrigenda are not read. Pending owner.
rules.lists: UK and US: the stored copy relied on is the latest copy of the list SanctionDesk retrieved on or before the date (the UTC date of its first retrieval). SanctionDesk only knows files it has downloaded: before its first stored copy the status is 'not established', as it is when the latest copy by then could not be read; a list changed and changed back between two downloads is not seen. A copy stating an earlier date than the version before it is passed over. Only entries of kind Vessel count. Pending owner.
rules.matching: Matching is on the IMO number only (check digit verified); names are shown as each source gives them.
rules.future: A date after today is 'not established' in every jurisdiction.

how_to_read: For an IMO number and a date on or before 'as_of': in each jurisdiction, take the interval of vessels[imo][jurisdiction] containing the date (from and to inclusive, null for open); where the IMO number or the jurisdiction is absent, take timeline[jurisdiction]'s status. The stored copy relied on is sources[jurisdiction][ref] of timeline[jurisdiction]'s interval containing the date; 'ref' on a vessel interval names its entries in entries[jurisdiction]; 'pending' lists [effect, act CELEX, entries] for acts in sources.acts; timeline.eu 'not_read' lists acts pending then whose text was not read in full. A date after 'as_of' is not established.
